# Hunger Free Kasaragod

> Hunger Free Kasaragod is the food-relief initiative of Live to Smile Foundation (also "LTS Foundation"), a charitable organisation based in Kasaragod district, Kerala, India. It serves free warm breakfasts to people living on the streets, delivers grocery kits to 100 vulnerable households every month, supports isolated villages through "Food On Call", and rescues surplus food from weddings and birthdays through "Celebrating Together".

## Facts
- Organisation: Live to Smile Foundation (LTS Foundation), Kasaragod, Kerala, India
- Initiative: Hunger Free Kasaragod
- Areas served: Kasaragod, Cherkala, Kanhangad, and remote interior villages of Kasaragod district; disaster relief sent to Wayanad (landslides)
- Confirmed figure: 100 grocery kits delivered every month
- Recognition: Partnership Award from the District Collector of Kasaragod
- Languages: English, Malayalam

## Programs
- [Daily Food](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/daily-food): warm breakfasts for people on the streets; dry ration kits for struggling families
- [100 Kit / Month](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/100-kit-month): grocery kits to 100 households in remote rural Kasaragod every month
- [Food On Call](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/food-on-call): food support for isolated villages overlooked by urban aid
- [Celebrating Together](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/celebrating-together): surplus food collected from weddings and birthdays in food-grade containers, packed into ready-to-eat meals, stored in a refrigerated hub and distributed the same or next day
- [Smile and Care](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/smile-and-care): food, shelter, clothing, medical care and education support
- [Education Support](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/education-support): fee support for students
- [I Lead Store](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/i-lead-store): online store for handmade products by differently-abled students
- [Blanket Distribution](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/blanket-distribution): blankets during the cold season
- [Wayanad Relief](https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/programs/wayanad-relief): disaster relief supplies after the Wayanad landslides

## How to help or get help
- Donate surplus food from an event: https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/food-rescue
- Request food for someone in need: https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/request-help
- Donate: https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/donate
- Volunteer: https://www.ltsfoundation.in/en/volunteer
